messages:
amanda (docs): Heads up — PR #6721 updates rate/quota examples for SDKv6 but I noticed the dashboard panel IDs and plan labels don't match. Can someone sanity-check before I merge? Link: https://confluence.redwood/internal/docs/ratecap-samples
raj (eng): On it, @amanda. Which panel ID are you seeing?
amanda (docs): The docs reference panel `txq-usage-3` but the dashboard title is 'Usage by plan' and the metric name is `usage_plan`. Also the example header uses `x-rw-quota`; for SDKv6 we standardized on `x-rw-usage-plan`. Small patch suggestion below:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\\\n  -H "x-rw-usage-plan: enterprise" \\\\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage
```
luisa (pm): We intentionally migrated terminology to "plan" in the product brief — can we align docs to call it plan everywhere? If we keep an alias note for legacy headers that's fine.
matt (data): Agree on using `plan`. Suggest adding a one-line migration note: "legacy header `x-rw-quota` maps to `x-rw-usage-plan`". Also we should mention burst credits/grace behavior in the quota section.
amanda (docs): Good call. I'll switch examples to `plan`, add the migration note, and add one sentence about burst/grace credits. @raj can you confirm the panel metric/title so I can update the dashboard link in the doc? @deploy-bot can we run docs lint on the PR?
deploy-bot: docs-ci: lint check started for PR #6721
raj (eng): Confirmed — dashboard panel `txq-usage-3` has metric `usage_plan` and the title shows as "Usage by plan". Docs should reference the panel URL (dashboard?id=txq-usage-3) and call out the metric name in parentheses for clarity. Pushing a tiny commit to the branch to update the panel link and add a comment in the PR.
deploy-bot: docs-ci: lint check passed ✅
luisa (pm): :thumbsup: Also prefer the UX wording "grace credits" not "burst" in the user-facing docs. Maybe: "Grace credits (sometimes called burst credits) are consumed before plan quota depletion."
amanda (docs): I'll add that sentence verbatim and include an inline callout under the quotas section. I'll also add a short Python SDKv6 snippet for header mapping. Draft snippet below — feel free to tweak:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${TOKEN}")
client.headers.update({"x-rw-usage-plan": "enterprise"})
resp = client.get("/v1/usage")
```
matt (data): That Python snippet looks good. I'll add a 1-line JS snippet too in a follow-up commit.
amanda (docs): Assigning reviews to @raj and @matt — will merge after both +1.
raj (eng): +1
matt (data): +1
amanda (docs): Merged PR #6721 and backfilled the dashboard link and migration note. Closing thread — thanks everyone!
